findings.title: Error-summary labels and join both use colons, producing double-colon rows
findings.evidence: base_label: "guarantor_name" -> "Guarantor: name" (error_summary.gleam:177); join_label_message False branch: label <> ": " <> message (form_pages.gleam:521); error tuple #(scope("guarantor_name"), "Your guarantor\u{2019}s full name.") (application_handler.gleam:655). Rendered: "Guarantor: name: Your guarantor\u{2019}s full name."
findings.detail: Labels changed "Guarantor — name" -> "Guarantor: name" while the join changed " — " -> ": ", so every reference/guarantor/co-applicant error row renders a double colon. Old em-dash join never collided. User-visible on the public /apply error summary.
findings.recommended_fix: Space-join when the label already contains a colon (extend the ?/! case), or use a different internal separator in base_label. Label-internal and label-message separators must not both be colons.

findings.title: empty_to_dash now returns a hyphen, not a dash: misleading name
findings.evidence: fn empty_to_dash(s: String) -> String { case s { "" -> "-" other -> other } }
findings.detail: Function name and doc comment say 'dash' but the placeholder is now a hyphen ("-"). The change itself is deliberate (PR body: 'Placeholder dashes ... -> "-"'), so only the name/comment are stale. AI report cover page renders '-' for missing risk_level/analysis_timestamp.
findings.recommended_fix: Rename to empty_to_hyphen (or keep a dash placeholder if a lone hyphen reads as a typo on the cover page).

findings.title: KEEP-IN-SYNC comment claims checklist item 6 ALSO lives in form_draft.js, but it doesn't

findings.recommended_fix: Reword to 'The continue-link button strings ALSO live in priv/static/form_draft.js' (drop the item-6 claim) or add the mirror to form_draft.js.

findings.title: join_label_message space-join branch (for '?'/'!' labels) has no test
findings.evidence: fn join_label_message(label: String, message: String) -> String { case string.ends_with(label, "?") || string.ends_with(label, "!") { True -> label <> " " <> message ... } }
findings.detail: New function's True branch exists only for the listing_source label ('Where did you find this listing?'); no test renders that error or asserts the join. A regression to '...listing?: msg' ships unchecked.
findings.recommended_fix: Unit-test join_label_message covering both branches, or add a form_with_errors render with a listing_source error.

findings.title: Prep-block checklist item 6 pinned only by non-distinguishing substrings on the form surface

findings.title: movement_indicator_none_test hyphen assertion is vacuous (matches the testid, not the placeholder)
findings.evidence: html |> string.contains("-") |> should.be_true (test); span carries attribute("data-testid", "movement-none"), class("text-slate text-sm"), [html.text("-")]
findings.detail: After the em-dash -> hyphen swap, contains("-") is satisfied by the testid/class hyphens (movement-none, text-slate, text-sm). Deleting html.text("-") would still pass. 4 lenses independently reported this.
findings.recommended_fix: Pin the text node (assert ">-<") or drop the line; the data-testid and aria-label assertions already prove the none state renders.

findings.title: no_em_dash_test checks the same U+2014 character twice (redundant ||)
findings.detail: The \u{2014} escape and the literal em-dash are the same character, so the || compares identical booleans. Harmless but dead duplication.

findings.title: no_em_dash_test comment claims a global copy ban but can only reach toast/page strings

findings.recommended_fix: Narrow the comment to 'all copy.toast/page strings' or add the repo-wide grep lint the comment implies.

findings.title: Spec artifact's verification rg commands miss a literal em-dash in priv/static JS and shared/src
findings.evidence:
- `rg -n '\\u\{2014\}|—' server/src client/src server/priv/static shared/src --glob '*.{gleam,js}'` ...
- `rg -n '—' server/src client/src --glob '*.gleam' ...`
findings.detail: The escaped/entity scan doesn't match the literal character, and the literal scan is scoped to server/src + client/src .gleam only — a literal em-dash in priv/static JS or shared/src gleam escapes both. Current tree is clean (remaining hits are comments/logs), so this is doc accuracy, not a live gap.
findings.recommended_fix: Update the artifact's commands to scan the literal character across all four roots with both globs.
